uart.chip_formula: 10 bit times x (8 if U2X else 16) x (UBRR+1) cycles (ATmega328P USART baud equations; the divisor is read from the build's own hal.c / board_config.h)

what.functions: cycles per call, entry -> ret, in the -fno-inline build (atom as a node; includes everything it calls and any interrupt that landed inside); the caller's CALL (4 cycles) is not counted
what.isrs: cycles per interrupt, vector taken -> reti, in the shipped hex
what.loop: cycles between two visits of the loop's poll point, by the way the loop came back, in the shipped hex
what.masked: ipb-7: cycles with SREG.I cleared in main-line code outside ISRs (cli -> the instruction that set I again), per opening pc with its enclosing function, in the shipped hex
what.mean: a function's mean is not offered by the twin (n / min / max only); an interrupt's is
